policy: A React-specific renderer or integration may remain handwritten only when current technical evidence requires it. Historical existence is never sufficient. Every retained path must have an owner, evidence, exit criteria, and a reviewable source record.

resolvedTemporaryLegacy.reason: ToastProvider owns React context and lifecycle integration rather than an alternate canonical DOM renderer, and the active ADR-008 exception records its technical reason, evidence, owner, and exit criteria.

nonRendererIntegrationApis.reason: useToast is a React hook/service binding, not a component renderer, and remains governed by the ADR-008 integration exception until a shared service contract can generate framework bindings.

rules: The React migration matrix must contain no temporary-legacy strategy after MFD-1415.
Every active or retiring React ADR-008 exception must contain every registry-required field, at least one source path, current evidence, and substantive exit criteria.
Every retained React source path recorded by an ADR-008 exception must exist in the repository.
Every Batch-5 or Batch-6 parity blocker must carry technical rationale and exit criteria and point to existing source files.
No exception may be justified by historical existence, prior ownership, or convenience alone.
